snippet.title: Spinbot - #1 Trailer
snippet.description:
Now you are the no-life hacker. Wishlist SPINBOT on Steam today. (thank you!!)

👉 WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4501650/Spinbot/
👉 PLAY THE DEMO ON ITCH.IO: https://passionforfonts.itch.io/spinbot

ABOUT THE GAME:
Ever wondered what it's like to be the "No-Life Cheater" everyone hates? In SPINBOT, you’re exactly that. This is a roguelike survival shooter where you blast through lobbies of unsuspecting players using your... enhanced skills.

Upgrade your PC: Improve your rig and your "WordProcessor.exe" (totally not a cheat client) with help from your girlfriend, Carla.

Loot & Profit: Find cases, sell skins, and survive the chaos.

The Grind: How long can you stay undetected?

We are a small team of two building this in Godot. We’d love to hear your thoughts, so drop a comment below and we’ll get back to you!

Follow our journey:
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/spinbotthegame.bsky.social
Discord: https://discord.gg/afJFzgWRna
#Spinbot #IndieGame #GodotEngine #RetroFPS #Roguelike #PSXStyle #HL1
